notes.title: [Update]Added Multiple Screen Resolution Options, Boss Health GUI And Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

It has been a while since the last update. I have been working on some of the most requested features of the game.

Here is the list of features added to the game.

[b]1. Multiple Screen Resolution Options:[/b]
Now, you can go to options, then Video Settings, and adjust to the following resolutions as per your requirements(best fit for your monitor)-
"1920x1080"
"1600x900"
"1400x1050"
"1366x768"
"1280x720"
"1024x768"
"800x480"
"640x480"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37317832/f76feaa516fd09240de6ff33f41dc4c90e0d41ff.png[/img]

However, more options can be added in the future. This feature has been added just now and it might not be that perfect but it is still better than not having it in the first place. All of my future releases will have this option from the start.
[b]
2. Added Boss Health GUI: [/b]You can now be able to see the Boss health GUI in order to track how much health the boss has when fighting the boss. 

[b]3. Reducing the difficulty of the final boss battle:[/b] One of the players suggested to reduce the difficulty of the final boss battle. I personally played though it and found that it could be really frustrating for the player to not be able to finish the level because of the difficulty. So, I have made slightly easier for the player to defeat the final boss. Don't worry, I have made it in such a way that it is still fun and the player feel satisfied after defeating the final boss, thereby, providing the player with the sense of accomplishment.

4. Added some health items to some of the levels where there is huge spike in difficulty to make it a less frustrating experience for the player. 

5. Fixed some minor bugs.

This is considered to be a major update since the release. However, if you encounter any bug while playing the game please feel free to let me know. I will take  a look.

[b]Note:[/b] With this major update, I will raise the price of this game to $3.99(waiting for Valve's approval) and mostly because of the inflation, and to cover the development costs. However, players who have already bought the game will get this update along with all of the future updates for free. Thank you so much for your continuous support! It was not possible for me to come to this far without your support. 

Happy Gaming!

Best Regards,
Anamik
